rationale: The pain is genuinely severe when it occurs — complete CI/CD shutdown with no support escalation path — but evidence of frequency is thin: only a single HN post with 7 points, no corroborating complaint threads, job postings, or competitor products specifically solving this problem. There is no willingness-to-pay signal (no competitor charging for contributor vetting, no quotes from maintainers asking for a paid solution), and the root cause is a GitHub platform policy issue that GitHub itself could patch, making long-term defensibility near-zero. The pain fails the minimum evidence bar (5 distinct pain quotes, 1 WTP signal) required for promotion.
